jobs.instruction: On the right wall, the brass-framed mirror at about x 0.85–0.98, y 0.26–0.63 is a tall portrait rectangle with about 9 columns and 12 rows of tiles. Replace it with a true-square shallow brass frame mounted low on the wall, its bottom edge just above the paving and with a slight backward tilt, holding an even square grid of exactly 9 by 9 = 81 equal flat tiles. Keep its reflections of the golden-lit lanterns, keep the same blue alcove, padded seat and plant to its left, and change nothing else in the image.
